text_block_list.text:
For this year's Fan Appreciation Festival,
Rose Kingdom had volunteered to serve
as a member of the executive committee.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because this Fan Appreciation
Festival is happening now,
I believe we require events that will truly
inspire vitality.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Where we must focus our efforts most
is the main stage... In other words.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What if we used streaming equipment—
which has grown increasingly popular in
recent years—to broadcast our stage event?

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committ...
text_block_list.text:
I see! That's true,
even those who find it difficult to go
outside right now can enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committ...
text_block_list.text:
If you possess that much passion...
would you mind taking charge of the main
stage,
if it isn't too much trouble?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Though I accepted the request...
what sort of program should be held on the
main stage?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Something that shines a brighter light into
the heart.
Something to nourish our steps forward—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Paying it no heed,
Moss commands that banquet all alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so the grand banquet commenced—
Moss laid out a feast in the square,
played music,
and kept the festivities roaring late into
the night.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so, they each would say:
"My heart has grown brighter."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Alright—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("Words of encouragement"—
"Introducing races that inspire
vitality"...
Will this truly suffice?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... I cannot see the right answer.
"Something to nourish everyone's steps
forward"—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(There is still much to be done.
...To think I would stumble so at the very
outset.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rose? You doing okay?
Weren't you spacing out during class, too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this crazy rare?
Are you getting ready for the Thanksgiving
Festival?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Tosen Jordan and Gold City.
Both are kind classmates well-versed in
fashion.
Jordan is currently an active racer,
if I recall—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Yes, but—there is no issue.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I am currently brainstorming ideas for
the main stage.
Yet, no fitting program comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
I should have paid proper attention in
class.
I appreciate your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. ...Speaking of which,
plans for the main stage, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, Fan Fest is basically a party,
right?
So, like,
wouldn't it be way better if we just made
it super party-ish?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, an eating contest,
or a quiz showdown?
Oh, or maybe a runway walk?!
Sounds so fun!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I-Is... is that so?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...When I'm completely wiped out,
rather than being told
"Hang in there, don't give up"—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, though,
watching Jordan and the others crack up
while showing me weird videos does way more
to blow off steam.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(To arrive so swiftly at an answer
I couldn't reach even after days...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(How utterly obstinate—or rather,
is it simply a lack of understanding regarding
common entertainment?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To the both of you...
you have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, it's fine! Besides—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Anyone who's free, get over here,
quick!
Emergency, big emergency~!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
“What's up?” “You're loud!” “Heeey!”
“What happened?” “Need a hand with
something?”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, come on,
stuff like this is way better when we all
do it together!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
True that.
Anyone here know their stuff about stream
events?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, and thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Accept this! The requested recipe list
for the mocktail tasting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The indoor stream's...
traffic flow diagram is also complete...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Upperclassmen.
I thank you for your dedicated efforts.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(A mocktail recipe that speaks of great
care.
An exquisitely detailed layout of foot
traffic.
—Could I have ever prepared something so
thoroughly?)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Negotiations for the main stage live
performers
are complete. Everyone is able to appear.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The meeting has already concluded and the
materials
have been shared. Do look them over,
if you please.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
All the equipment for the racing outfit
runway is ready to go, too~!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you.
On my own,
such swift progress would have been entirely
out of reach...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you need food for the big-eating
challenge,
my family's diner can help out~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, I came up with a few ideas
for the quiz tournament questions...
Would you mind taking a look?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
We came up with a comedy routine!
We really want to perform it between the
main stage acts.
What do you think!?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
The equipment is in flawless order.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still,
for the academy festival to turn out
so remarkably diverse—

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committ...
text_block_list.text: Everyone's sure to enjoy it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, indeed.
It truly is thanks to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committ...
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
To the Tracen Academy Fan Appreciation
Festival!!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committ...
text_block_list.text:
All the concerts and events on the main
stage are scheduled to be streamed!
And on the sub-stream,
we'll air short segments touring the classroom
events!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...?!
I did think there were an awful lot of camera
crews.
They're really pulling out all the stops
this year~.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like some people I know were watching
the stream too!
They were really hyped for it~.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it seems it is about time.
Trainer.

Where I went alongside her was――a runway
where Umamusume
and their trainers walked together in full
costume.
(Kyaaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Trainer!” “I watched the Japan Cup!”
“So wonderful~!” “The stream chat is going
wild too!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Let us be off.
(Nooooooo!!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your appearance.
I must admit,
I am hardly accustomed to this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to that,
the fans were delighted.
I could even hear cheers for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems we've become quite well-known as
we've walked this path together.
Even I feel proud.

The lively excitement of the Fan Appreciation
Festival showed no sign of dying down.
And that was true not only across the academy
grounds—

It was one of the event's attractions:
a livestream.
The premise was to converse with fans over
the broadcast
for a set period of time, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Has it begun already?

Looks like I'll be needing cue cards quite
a bit today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...Everyone,
thank you for tuning in to my stream.
I am Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'I've been looking forward to this,' thank
you.
'I watched the Nikkei Shinshun Hai,' thank
you.
'Why that outfit?' We discussed it together
as a team."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Rose's visuals go hard”...? My apologies,
I am unfamiliar with such terminology and
cannot grasp its meaning—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Grass”...? Grass...?
“Your Majesty~!” Calling me in a manner akin
to Ruler, are they?
“Your Majesty! Your Majesty!” You as well,
I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I can't keep up with replying.
choice_data_list: ("I don't believe you need to repl...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? However,
would it not be discourteous to ignore
them?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“It's just how it is.” “Don't worry about
it.”
Is that so...? I see...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, unfairness cannot be tolerated.
If I have resolved not to reply,
I must see it through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
'I love the Rose Clan so much.'
Is that so? Thank you.

The lively excitement of the Fan Appreciation
Festival showed no sign of dying down.
And that was true not only across the academy
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"The eating contest was so fun!" "Oguri and
Spe are unstoppable."
"Golshi was an absolute menace in the
quiz!" "The outfits on the runway were
gorgeous~!"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
“Watching this with my grandma.”
“Haven't laughed this hard in ages.”
“Please stream again next year!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It seems everyone is enjoying themselves.

The Fan Appreciation Festival proceeded
smoothly.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The finale of the Fan Thanksgiving
will be a livestreamed event.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To those beyond the camera:
though there is a slight delay,
your comments are flowing onto the stage as
well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us unite as one and share a truly
wonderful time together!

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
“Comments are flying by!” “Can you see
us~~?!”
“Her fan service to the stage-left cam is
insane, look everyone!”
“Couldn't make it in person,
but this is great in its own way.”

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
“Your voice (becomes my strength)
Your voice (shapes the future)
Let us share the same dream,
now and forevermore”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone passing by wore a smile without
exception.
This Fan Appreciation Festival must be...
a success, then.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Alone, I surely could never
have achieved this result.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Devising the program felt like
trying to grasp a cloud...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(......—
I truly leaned on so many helping hands.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... Were it King Moss, even alone,
he would have created a day filled with
hope.)
